# Site-wide crawler and AI-use preferences

This is a public GitHub Pages site, not an authenticated or private service.
The owner requests that automated systems do NOT scrape, train on, archive,
republish, catalog, profile, or track activities from any page or file on
this site, including the homepage, conference pages, research explainers,
tracker, and all machine-readable data assets.

All published HTML pages specify meta robots noindex,nofollow so compliant
search engines can fetch those pages only to detect exclusion and remove
them from search indexes. AI crawlers are asked not to crawl any path via
robots.txt. These policies are voluntary, not enforceable access controls.

Anyone who already knows the URL of a public asset can still request it.
Private data should be kept outside public GitHub repositories and Pages.
